name: box
description: Pads its content on all sides, with an optional border and an optional surface.

attributes.name: data-gap-inline
attributes.description: Padding on the two sides only, over whatever data-gap set: a band wide at the sides and ordinary top and bottom.

attributes.name: data-gap-block
attributes.description: Padding top and bottom only, over whatever data-gap set.

attributes.name: data-surface
attributes.description: Fill the box with one of the three surface tones and set the page text on it, making it a visible panel. Absent, the box is transparent and only its padding does anything.

markers.name: data-border
markers.description: Draw a border of the border width, in the border color. Works on any element; it is a box's most common marker, which is why it is listed here.

markers.name: data-paint
markers.description: Fill this element with a color by name: a hue at its base step with the text made for it, a constant, or a step of the greyscale. Up to grey-40 the text stays the page text; from grey-50 it becomes the page surface.

markers.name: data-text
markers.description: Color this element's words by name, from the same list. On an element that is also painted it wins over the automatic text color.

tokens.name: --yeti-color-surface
tokens.description: The fill at data-surface="base"; the page's own surface.

tokens.name: --yeti-color-surface-raised
tokens.description: The fill at data-surface="raised", a step above the page.

tokens.name: --yeti-color-surface-sunken
tokens.description: The fill at data-surface="sunken", a step below the page.

a11y.notes: Purely visual. A box has no semantics; use a section or article element when the content is one.
